map.CDAI 的设计基于患者 7 天内的症状频率（稀便次数、腹痛等），以平滑单日波动: CDAI is designed from the frequency of symptoms over 7 days (loose stool frequency, abdominal pain and so on), smoothing single-day variation to reflect overall activity. The more accurate the diary, the more reliable the score; short-term recall bias over- or under-estimates it.
map.CDAI<150 传统定义为临床缓解，但需结合内镜下黏膜愈合（目前治疗目标）综合: CDAI <150 is traditionally defined as clinical remission, but it must be judged together with endoscopic mucosal healing (the current treatment target). CDAI may stay low when fistulas or perianal lesions appear, so specialist assessment is still needed and follow-up must not be relaxed on the score alone.
